caption: The drawing depicts three human figures and a building. In the upper part of the drawing, there is a man with light skin, brown hair, and sideburns standing on a wooden platform behind a lectern, wearing a black suit with a white collar and a red scarf. In front of him, to his left, sits a girl with long blonde hair, light skin, a blue dress, and black shoes; she is sitting on a wooden box. To his right, another girl with brown hair, light skin, a pink dress, and black shoes sits on a similar wooden box. Below this scene, the lower half of the drawing shows a rectangular building with a brown shingled roof, cream-colored walls with reddish-brown accents, a set of double arched doors with decorative patterns in the center, three arched windows (two on one visible side and one on the front), and a stone-like base. The building also features a small black weather vane or fixture on the roof. The drawing uses muted tones of brown, blue, pink, black, and cream, and is enclosed within a thin, rectangular border. The artist’s name, Eugene La Foret, is written at the bottom right inside the border.
title: Toy School House
